ui.agents.skills.action.copy.note: Header action on a read-only skill. Makes a same-name editable copy in the reader's own skills folder.

ui.agents.skills.action.copying.note: Replaces the Copy to my skills label while the copy is being made.

ui.agents.skills.action.remove.note: More-actions menu item on a local skill. The ellipsis says a confirmation follows.

ui.agents.skills.action.remove_confirm.note: Confirms removing a local skill in the Remove dialog.

ui.agents.skills.alert.builtin_body.note: Says why it is read-only and the way out (the Copy to my skills button beside it). Keep Local Operator in Latin.

ui.agents.skills.alert.builtin_title.note: Info alert on a skill that ships with the app.

ui.agents.skills.alert.bundle_body.note: Keep Agent Hub in Latin (product name).

ui.agents.skills.alert.bundle_title.note: Info alert on a skill stored as a folder bundle rather than a single document.

ui.agents.skills.alert.conflict_body.note: Under the shared title 'This changed while you were editing'. The Reload button follows.

ui.agents.skills.alert.external_body.note: Says why it is read-only and the two ways out.

ui.agents.skills.alert.external_title.note: Info alert on a skill found in another tool's skills folder.

ui.agents.skills.alert.project_body.note: Says why it is read-only and the two ways out.

ui.agents.skills.alert.project_title.note: Info alert on a skill that belongs to a project folder.

ui.agents.skills.badge.new.note: Roster badge on a skill a configuration run created; cleared when the row is opened.

ui.agents.skills.badge.updated.note: Roster badge on a skill a configuration run changed; cleared when the row is opened.

ui.agents.skills.composer.about.note: Names the skill the next request is about. {name} is the skill's machine name, kept verbatim.

ui.agents.skills.composer.changed_below.note: Follows 'Updated {name} (skill): ' in the run summary. The pane above already shows the new text.

ui.agents.skills.composer.gate_backend.note: Shown when the backend cannot run skill changes. Must fit a 304 px box; wrapping is fine, clipping is not.

ui.agents.skills.composer.gate_none.note: Shown when no skill is open. Must fit a 304 px box.

ui.agents.skills.composer.gate_not_insta.note: Shown when the open hub skill is not on this machine.

ui.agents.skills.composer.gate_read_only.note: Shown for built-in, other-tool, project and bundle skills; the alert above says why.

ui.agents.skills.composer.kind.note: The noun in the '(skill)' suffix after 'Updated {name}'. Lowercase, in parentheses.

ui.agents.skills.composer.label.note: Accessible name of the composer box on the Skills tab.

ui.agents.skills.composer.no_changes.note: Shown when a configuration run finished and changed nothing.

ui.agents.skills.composer.placeholder.note: Invitation in the box when a skill is open. {name} is the skill's machine name. Must fit a 304 px box.

ui.agents.skills.detail.body_not_install.note: Detail view, for a row whose content is absent.

ui.agents.skills.detail.body_truncated.note: {size} is a formatted size such as '312 KB'. Never imply the text on screen is complete.
ui.agents.skills.detail.body_truncated.role: notice that the body is cut

ui.agents.skills.detail.body_unavailable.note: Detail view, for an installed skill whose body did not come back.

ui.agents.skills.detail.edit_by_asking.note: Under Instructions, says why there is no Edit button.

ui.agents.skills.detail.edit_by_asking_t.note: Under Instructions, says why there is no Edit button.

ui.agents.skills.detail.file_bytes.note: ICU plural. Used below 1 kB; larger sizes use a shared formatter.

ui.agents.skills.detail.files_truncated_.note: Shown when core listed fewer files than the folder holds. 'at least' is deliberate: when the folder walk itself was cut the total is a lower bound, so the sentence must stay true in both cases.
ui.agents.skills.detail.files_truncated_.role: notice that the file list is cut

ui.agents.skills.detail.fingerprint.note: Detail view, identity list. A content hash that changes when the skill's bytes change.

ui.agents.skills.detail.fingerprint_none.note: Backend gave no fingerprint (unreadable folder, or subscribed but not installed).

ui.agents.skills.detail.form.bundle.note: The skill is a folder with extra files.

ui.agents.skills.detail.form.document.note: The skill is one SKILL.md document.

ui.agents.skills.detail.form_label.note: Detail view, identity list. Followed by the value.

ui.agents.skills.detail.front_matter_lab.note: Label in Details for YAML keys other than name and description, shown verbatim.

ui.agents.skills.detail.hub_local_note.note: Under the header of an editable hub skill. Keep Agent Hub in Latin.

ui.agents.skills.detail.location_label.note: Label in Details for where the skill is stored.

ui.agents.skills.detail.preview_aria.note: {path} is a relative file path and is never translated.
ui.agents.skills.detail.preview_aria.role: accessible name for a file preview region

ui.agents.skills.detail.preview_none.note: Binary or unreadable files have no text preview.

ui.agents.skills.detail.preview_truncate.role: notice that a file preview is cut

ui.agents.skills.detail.section.details.note: Collapsed section holding location, form and fingerprint.

ui.agents.skills.detail.section.files.note: Detail view. Files that sit beside SKILL.md and that the skill can point to.

ui.agents.skills.detail.show_all.note: Expands the clamped SKILL.md text in place. Same words as the Agents page's own Show all.

ui.agents.skills.detail.show_less.note: Collapses the expanded SKILL.md text again.

ui.agents.skills.edit.description_help.note: Under the 'When to use it' field in the inline edit.

ui.agents.skills.edit.instructions_help.note: Under the Instructions field in the inline edit.

ui.agents.skills.empty.builtin.note: Roster, Built-in segment selected, nothing in it.

ui.agents.skills.empty.hub.note: Roster, Agent Hub segment selected, nothing in it. Keep Agent Hub in Latin.

ui.agents.skills.empty.local.note: Roster, Local segment selected, nothing in it.

ui.agents.skills.empty.none.note: The skills tab has nothing to list at all (no built-in, hub, local, external or project skills were found). Distinct from the no-match sentence.

ui.agents.skills.empty.search.note: {query} is what the reader typed, echoed verbatim between curly quotes. Distinct from the nothing-at-all sentence.
ui.agents.skills.empty.search.role: empty roster sentence after a search

ui.agents.skills.error.detail_meaning.note: Two plausible causes, stated plainly, no blame.
ui.agents.skills.error.detail_meaning.role: explanation of a failed details read

ui.agents.skills.error.detail_title.note: {name} is the skill's identifier, shown between curly quotes.

ui.agents.skills.error.meaning.note: Says the failure is about reading, not about any skill being changed.
ui.agents.skills.error.meaning.role: reassurance line of a failed read

ui.agents.skills.error.title.note: What happened, first line of a three-part failure block (what, meaning, retry).

ui.agents.skills.error.what_fallback.note: Used only when the failure carries no message of its own.
ui.agents.skills.error.what_fallback.role: fallback sentence when the backend gave no message

ui.agents.skills.error.write_fallback.note: Shown under 'That did not save' when the backend gave no sentence of its own.

ui.agents.skills.hub.unlinked.note: A skill the hub manages whose link could not be matched. Not the same as 'Not downloaded': the skill IS on this machine.

ui.agents.skills.hub.unlinked_help.note: Detail view only. Calm; no instruction to fix anything.
ui.agents.skills.hub.unlinked_help.role: explanation of the unconfirmed hub link

ui.agents.skills.hub.update_failed.note: Status mark in a Skills roster row and the details header, shown when a hub skill's last update did not complete. Short: it shares a row with the skill name and must not crowd it. Deliberately NOT the Hub page's 'Update failed — open to retry': this read-only surface has no retry control, so it must not promise one. No placeholders.
ui.agents.skills.hub.update_failed.role: status mark in a roster row

ui.agents.skills.list_aria.note: Names the list of skill rows for assistive tech; same word as the tab.
ui.agents.skills.list_aria.role: accessible name for the roster list

ui.agents.skills.notice.copied.note: After Copy to my skills succeeded. {name} is the skill's machine name.

ui.agents.skills.notice.saved.note: After an inline edit saved. {name} is the skill's machine name.

ui.agents.skills.remove.body.note: Remove dialog for a local skill.

ui.agents.skills.remove.discard_confirm.note: Second confirmation when the hub copy has unpublished edits.

ui.agents.skills.remove.title.note: Remove dialog for a local skill. {name} is the skill's machine name.

ui.agents.skills.remove.unpublished_body.note: Second confirmation on a hub skill with local edits. Keep Agent Hub in Latin.

ui.agents.skills.remove.unpublished_titl.note: Second confirmation on a hub skill with local edits.

ui.agents.skills.retrying.note: Replaces 'Retry' while the failed read is being repeated. Ellipsis character, not three dots.
ui.agents.skills.retrying.role: busy label of the Retry button

ui.agents.skills.scope_legend.note: Accessible name of the All / Local / Agent Hub / Built-in segments above the roster.

ui.agents.skills.search.note: Placeholder of the roster search while the Skills tab is open. Mirrors 'Search agents' and 'Search teams'.

ui.agents.skills.search_aria.note: No visible label exists, so this is the field's only name while the Skills tab is open.
ui.agents.skills.search_aria.role: accessible name for the roster search

ui.agents.skills.select_prompt.note: Shown when no skill is open. 'Read-only' tells the reader nothing on this tab can be edited yet. One calm sentence, no call to action.
ui.agents.skills.select_prompt.role: hint in the empty detail column

ui.agents.skills.select_prompt_editable.note: Detail pane with nothing open, when this backend can change skills.

ui.agents.skills.source.builtin.note: Where a skill lives. Same word as the Agents scope filter 'Built-in'.
ui.agents.skills.source.builtin.role: source label: ships with the app

ui.agents.skills.source.external.note: A skill found in a folder owned by another coding tool (for example Claude or Codex). Read-only here.
ui.agents.skills.source.external.role: source label: another tool's skills folder

ui.agents.skills.source.hub.note: 'Agent Hub' is the product name and stays untranslated if the locale keeps product names in Latin script.
ui.agents.skills.source.hub.role: source label: managed from Agent Hub

ui.agents.skills.source.local.note: A skill the reader keeps in their own skills folder with no hub link.
ui.agents.skills.source.local.role: source label: made on this machine

ui.agents.skills.source.project.note: A skill found in the skills folder of a project. Read-only here.
ui.agents.skills.source.project.role: source label: a project folder's skills

ui.agents.skills.source.unknown.note: Shown when the backend sends a source this version does not know.

ui.agents.skills.state.following.note: Header meta line of a subscribed hub skill: 'Agent Hub · Following updates'.

ui.agents.skills.state.hub_unknown.note: Header meta line when the hub links list did not answer.

ui.agents.skills.state.not_installed.note: Roster line two and header of a subscribed hub skill with no copy on this machine.

ui.agents.skills.state.read_only.note: Header meta line of a built-in, other-tool or project skill: 'Built-in · Read-only'.

ui.agents.skills.state.updates_off.note: Roster line two and header of a hub skill with its subscription turned off.

ui.agents.skills.tab.note: The third tab of the Agents page. One short noun, sentence case; the count is rendered next to it separately.
ui.agents.skills.tab.role: tab label beside Agents and Teams

ui.agents.skills.where.hub.note: Detail view, 'Where it lives' section. Agent Hub is the product name.

ui.agents.skills.where.unknown.note: Detail view, 'Where it lives' section, for an unrecognised source.
